purpose: Which defect invalidated which artifact, and what was done about it. A defect log says what went wrong; this says what it CONTAMINATED. Without it a reader cannot tell whether a number in this tree was produced before or after the fix that concerns it.
rule: An artifact touched by a defect is either QUARANTINED (moved under failures/superseded/, cited nowhere) or REGENERATED after the fix. Nothing tainted is reported.

edges.what: negative predicted win probability from the source's opponent sign flip
edges.resolution: QUARANTINED before the amendment was written; every K-sweep arm ran after the root-frame conversion

edges.what: wall-clock K confound, then per-K compute overhead in the guard
edges.resolution: QUARANTINED and re-run under a decision budget with a K-aware guard

edges.what: multi-select payloads emitted a single option, on the fallback and then the searched path
tainted: arms whose INVALID games came from minCount > 1 selects
the M08 rollout-bias ceiling, measured with the pre-D13 payload path
edges.resolution: arms re-run; the M08 ceiling carries a REQUIRED_REMEASUREMENT_AFTER_D13 obligation recorded in PREREGISTERED_AGGREGATION.json
edges.caveat: the ceiling figure is reported WITH its obligation, not as if unaffected

edges.what: an orphaned arm from a killed sweep wrote results into the live tree using pre-fix code
edges.resolution: QUARANTINED; tools/c022_sweep.sh gained `set -m` and a process-group EXIT trap
edges.recurrence: D28 is the resource variant of the same root cause -- kills that target a parent leave children alive. Those orphans could not write (their queues had no live consumer), so unlike D12 they tainted no artifact.

edges.what: the B1.5 rung was a no-op; then the B06 check compared the learner against mu; then B06 ran once in 556 policy versions
tainted: the entire controlled rung ladder, conf_* and ctrl_*, across three code versions
edges.resolution: QUARANTINED in failures/superseded/ladder_pre_d19/ and failures/superseded/ctrl_rungs_br15_noop/; the ladder was re-run in full from ONE commit
edges.why_the_whole_ladder: MANDATORY_IMPLEMENTATION B7 requires one codebase to produce the stages. A ladder assembled from three versions of the fidelity check is not that, even where individual rungs were internally valid.

edges.what: ctrl_BR0 ran under a concurrent MCGS arm; its learner ramped 1.24 -> 4.60 updates/s as that arm drained
tainted: ctrl_BR0's production/consumption ratio, queue age, policy lag AND its learned policy
edges.resolution: re-run alone; EXECUTION_BUDGET's concurrency column amended to draw the line at the bounded blocking FIFO

edges.what: the validator's inventory omitted the paired arms, the noise floor, the deploy and unrestricted arms
tainted: every validation_report.json produced before the fix -- they reported 13/13 PASS having never examined the contract's decisive MCGS evidence
edges.resolution: REGENERATED. The inventory now covers all live arms and the report is 19/19 with 0 inert checks.
edges.note: no measurement was wrong; the checks were sound and pointed at the wrong data. The taint is on the VALIDATION, not on the arms.

edges.what: sims_per_decision reported as a mean dominated by two collapsed decisions (82,540 against a median of 610)
tainted: the M11 probe's headline figure, and the probe's own parallel-efficiency verdict, which divided one unstable mean by another and concluded nproc 6 was unusable
edges.resolution: REGENERATED. source_time arms report the full distribution and the top-3 share; the verdict uses medians.
edges.caveat: the mean is still reported, beside the share that produces it, because the gap between them is the finding

edges.what: the MCGS_HIDDEN_INFO attribution predicate was a sign test that returned PASS on a Brier difference of 0.00146
tainted: one STATUS.json in which MCGS_HIDDEN_INFO read PASS
edges.resolution: REGENERATED. The requirement now decomposes the improvement and demands the ensemble's own step clear the measured 0.0377 replication difference; the status is PARTIAL.
edges.severity: highest of any defect here. Every other inert check cost rework; this one would have converted the contract's central negative finding into a PASS on noise.

edges.what: the final panel scored 0 of 180 games in two seconds and emitted a champion_comparison anyway
tainted: one panel.json with credible_improvement: false reached from zero evidence
edges.resolution: REGENERATED after fixing agent construction; the panel now reports NO_DATA rather than a verdict when nothing scores
edges.note: the conclusion it reached was the one later confirmed. A wrong method producing the expected answer is the hardest kind to notice.

edges.what: three checks failed CORRECT behaviour -- V08 on legitimate opponent-flag conflicts, the ladder tool and V14 on a bounded rung's queue statistics
tainted: one validation_report in which V14 FAILED, which suppressed BYTERL_REFERENCE_FIDELITY to PARTIAL three levels down
edges.resolution: REGENERATED. Bounds now carry the regime they apply to.

edges.what: the 8x depth arm was cut by its per-game guard, abandoning 62.5% of its games against a comparison arm's 0%
tainted: k8_s768 -- its calibration was computed on the games that finish fast
edges.resolution: QUARANTINED in failures/superseded/depth_768_guard_bound/; the depth question re-asked at 4x, then blocked again by the same simulation cost

edges.what: my own foreground tooling ran during quiet-machine rungs; and eighteen orphaned workers held 24.7 GB from 19:51 onward
tainted: no artifact -- but every THROUGHPUT figure measured after 19:51 carries an unmeasured background load
edges.resolution: recorded rather than re-run: the affected numbers are wall-clock rates, and no reported conclusion rests on them. hardware/byterl_actor_scaling.json states that its rates are not comparable across runs and points here.
edges.caveat: D22's per-rung rates are understated in absolute terms; the DIFFERENCES between rungs are unaffected because the load was constant across them

how_to_verify_nothing_tainted_is_cited: tools/c022_field_balance.py excludes failures/ and superseded/ outright, and every analysis tool loads arms by explicit tag from a live directory rather than by glob. The one tool that globbed -- field_balance, on its first run -- immediately pulled five quarantined ft_k1 arms into an evidence table, which is why the exclusion is now explicit.
